instruction: Check the status of a 389 DS instance
Back up a 389 Directory Server instance
Configure a 389 DS instance with dsconf
output: dsconf localhost backend create --suffix dc=example,dc=com --backend-name userRoot

instruction: Set the root DN password in 389 DS

output: dsconf localhost security certificate add --name serverCert --file /tmp/cert.pem

instruction: Create a new user in 389 DS using dsidm
output: dsidm localhost user create --uid jdoe --cn 'John Doe' --displayName 'John Doe' --uidNumber 1001 --gidNumber 1001 --homeDirectory /home/jdoe

instruction: Delete a user in 389 DS with dsidm
Create a group in 389 DS with dsidm
Add a member to a group in 389 DS
output: dsidm localhost group add-member cn=mygroup,ou=groups,dc=example,dc=com uid=jdoe,ou=people,dc=example,dc=com

instruction: Reset a user password in 389 DS
output: dsidm localhost user reset password uid=jdoe,ou=people,dc=example,dc=com

instruction: Create a replication agreement in 389 DS
output: dsconf localhost repl-agmt create --suffix dc=example,dc=com --host consumer.example.com --port 389 --conn-protocol LDAP --bind-dn 'cn=replication,cn=config' --bind-passwd secret --agmt-name myAgmt
